collision_energy.evidence: HCD was performed using stepped collision energies of 25/30/35% and normalized AGC target was set to 100% with a maximum injection time of 100ms.
Precursors previously sequenced were excluded for 20 s, within a mass tolerance of 10 ppm.
The precursor ions were isolated within a 8.6 Da window with an m/z range of 400 and 1198; these were fragmented by HCD using normalized collision energy of 32%.
